args.prompt: The slide, then a hard freeze-frame on FAST. Insert: SLOW's two fingers slide a single nickel across the worn counter next to FAST's dime; in the background, out of focus, FAST's grin freezes. Camera: Macro on the counter. 1990s hand-painted cel anime, saturated colors, energetic limited animation with smear frames, film grain. Keep the art style, characters, faces, hair, outfits and any lettering exactly as in the first frame. Characters do not speak or sing; mouths stay closed or relaxed. No new text or subtitles.
args.negative_prompt: 3D render, CGI, photorealistic, morphing, warped faces, extra limbs, extra people, subtitles, captions, watermark, text changes
